name: Dan's Drive-In (Montpelier, ID) Golden Crispy Chicken Tenders Basket
whyItWorks: Whole white-meat chicken tenders provide easily digested lean protein. Dan's tenders have a light breading that digests well in remission.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Order the Chicken Tenders basket with honey or mild BBQ sauce for dipping; peel off crispy skin if feeling sensitive.
